direction: C1 publishes; C4 reads. One way. C2 never reads this contract at all.
transport: immutable content-addressed artefact in blob storage; pointer table holds active_version per (vertical, platform)
what_this_is: A Mechanism is a falsifiable hypothesis about WHY a content structure recurs among high performers.
It is mined from the tenant-neutral public exemplar corpus and from trend signals. It is NEVER mined from any tenant's outcome data.
It is therefore tenant-neutral BY CONSTRUCTION, not by a scoping check. C4 holds no tenant data, so C4 cannot leak any.
A Mechanism carries NO effect size and makes NO numeric prediction. See `forbidden_fields`.

A Pattern (see rubric-v1.json, tech-spec) is the different, tenant-scoped object that DOES carry an effect size, is estimated on internal outcome data conditioned on `arm`, and feeds VPS retrieval. A Mechanism is the prior. A Pattern is the likelihood. They are never merged.

forbidden_fields.description: These keys must never appear on a Mechanism. `additionalProperties: false` on the mechanism object enforces this: adding one breaks schema validation rather than silently shipping a laundered number.
forbidden_fields.why: The exemplar corpus's engagement signal is Proxy on every platform that matters (ADR-0001, Tier 3). ADR-0001 forbids a Proxy value from entering an effect-size calculation. A Mechanism reporting a lift would be exactly that laundering, wearing a new name.
forbidden_fields.why_arm: `arm` is reserved, systemwide, for the amplification arm (exploit|explore) on AmplificationAllocated and PerformanceSnapshot — 'the most valuable field in the system' (events-v1.json). A Mechanism has an `ingestion_arm`, which is a different concept about a different budget. The field names must never converge.

ingestion_arm.governed_by: the eval plan's REQ-005f coupling gate

ingestion_arm_is_not_the_amplification_a.rule: These are two different words that happen to rhyme. No Mechanism ever carries `arm`; no AmplificationAllocated ever carries `ingestion_arm`. A future author writing a bare `arm` on a mechanism is the hazard this block exists to name. No mechanism-derived value is ever an input to a budget allocation (ADR-0007).

number_travels_without_its_label.the_tension: ADR-0006 refuses a Proxy-labelled `effect_size` on the grounds that 'a number that exists gets copied into a slide, and the label does not come with it.' `prevalence_ratio` is also a number, and 2.45 reads like a 2.45x multiplier once detached from its wrapper. The asymmetry deserves an answer rather than silence.
number_travels_without_its_label.the_answer: Two different risks, and only one of them is a provenance violation. An `effect_size` mined over Proxy engagement would be a Proxy VALUE aggregated into a magnitude — ADR-0001's hard invariant, breached at the point of computation, before anyone copies anything. `prevalence_ratio` is a ratio of two deterministic COUNTS over a proxy-SELECTED set; no Proxy value is aggregated, displayed, or compared as Measured, so the hard invariant holds no matter where the number travels.
number_travels_without_its_label.the_residual_risk: What remains is misreading, not laundering: a reader may take 2.45 for a lift. This is mitigated but NOT eliminated. Mitigations: the field is never named `lift` or `effect_size`; `warrant`, `never_tested_against`, and the `Proxy-selected, Measured-evaluated` label ride on every response; and the forbidden-verb lexicon bars `causes|lifts|drives|predicts` from every statement. The residual risk is accepted and named here rather than argued away, because a mechanism with no quantity at all could not be falsified, and falsifiability is the entire point.

mechanism_library_version.description: No tenant_id. There is no tenant axis on this key.

compatible_extractor_versions.description: A predicate evaluated over extractor 3.2 FeatureRecords does not evaluate over 4.0. C4 serves the mechanism; anyone re-evaluating the predicate must honour this.

corpus_snapshot_sha256.description: The exact exemplar corpus the prevalences were counted over. Recomputable. This is what makes a falsification reproducible.

then.description: A `contrasted` mechanism MUST carry >= 2 temporal slices: the slice it was mined on, and a disjoint slice the asymmetry survived. A single-slice `contrasted` is a description of its own mining window and must fail validation, not merely violate prose. Disjointness itself (slice[i].to <= slice[i+1].from) is asserted by the synthesiser and re-checked at ratification; JSON Schema cannot express the cross-item comparison.

statement.description: The WHY, in prose. 'A first-person problem-statement delivered to camera inside 1.2s resolves a curiosity gap while signalling in-group membership, which is why it holds the scroll where a product shot does not.' Model-DRAFTED, human-RATIFIED, never machine-consumed. No downstream computation reads this field.

feature_predicate.description: Machine-evaluable condition over a FeatureRecord. This is the only part of a Mechanism that a machine may read. It is what makes the statement falsifiable rather than a story.

falsifier.description: REQUIRED. The observation that would sink this mechanism, stated before the evidence is gathered. A mechanism without a stated falsifier is not a mechanism, it is a caption. Mirrors the eval plan: 'If none of these tests can fail, none of them are tests.'

warrant.description: See warrant_ladder. Only `recurrent` and `contrasted` are served as active by C4. `falsified` is retained in the artefact for auditability and is never served as active.

n_creators.description: Independent creators. Ten posts by one creator is one creator, not ten data points.

n_cohorts.description: Distinct (vertical, platform) pairs the predicate independently recurs in, counted by cross-referencing other mechanism libraries. This is a RECURRENCE COUNT, not a pooling instruction: prevalences are computed strictly within this library's own cohort, and are never pooled across cohorts, because two (vertical, platform) populations are not one population.

n_trends.description: Count of UNRELATED trends whose exemplars carry this predicate. This is the operationalisation of 'trends are disposable, mechanisms compound' (ADR-0004). A predicate seen only inside one trend's posts is that trend wearing a lab coat.

prevalence_in_top_decile.description: Fraction of top-decile exemplar FeatureRecords satisfying the predicate. A COUNT over a proxy-SELECTED set, not an aggregation of proxy VALUES. The predicate itself is evaluated deterministically from media. Computed WITHIN this library's own cohort — never pooled across cohorts.

prevalence_in_contrast_set.description: Same predicate, same cohort, over the retained contrast set (see contrast_set_definition). If this is 0, prevalence_ratio is UNDEFINED, not infinite: the mechanism stays `conjectured` and the zero is surfaced. A predicate absent from every non-winner is more likely a corpus artefact than a discovery.

prevalence_ratio.description: prevalence_in_top_decile / prevalence_in_contrast_set, within this cohort. A DESCRIPTIVE ASYMMETRY on a proxy-selected sample. It is not a lift, not an effect size, not a risk ratio, and not causal. It is confounded by everything the corpus did not observe. It is served with `warrant` and `never_tested_against` attached precisely because a bare ratio, detached from its wrapper, reads like a multiplier — see number_travels_without_its_label.

contrast_set_definition.description: Named explicitly, because a prevalence without a comparison group is a number with no meaning. v1: the same creators' posts that did NOT reach their own top decile, extracted and retained alongside the top-decile corpus (C1 §1.5). Same creators controls for audience; same platform controls for format norms; nothing controls for the content nobody made.

temporal_slices.description: Ordered, non-overlapping: slice[i].to <= slice[i+1].from. Mined on slice 1, checked on slice 2. A `contrasted` mechanism MUST carry >= 2 (enforced by the allOf/if-then above), because a pattern that holds only in the window it was mined from is a description of that window. Disjointness is a cross-item comparison JSON Schema cannot express; it is enforced by the synthesiser and re-checked at ratification.

corpus_selection.description: Top-decile membership was decided using keyless public engagement reads. Proxy, always, per ADR-0001.

predicate_evaluation.description: The predicate is evaluated deterministically over the FeatureRecord extracted from the media itself. This is a real observation about the artefact.

label.description: The distinction that keeps this honest. No Proxy value is displayed, aggregated, or compared as Measured anywhere in this contract.

never_tested_against.const: content that was attempted and failed
never_tested_against.description: Shipped on every mechanism and on every API response. The exemplar corpus is a sample of winners (C1 §1.5). This field is the standing admission of survivorship bias, and it is not removable.

occasioned_by_trend_ids.description: Which trend(s) pointed the corpus builder here. A trend dies; the mechanism it occasioned does not. The archived trend remains queryable.

ingestion_arm.description: Which exemplar-ingestion policy surfaced this mechanism. Propagated from the exemplars that ground it; `mixed` where they span both. This is the stratifier for the eval plan's 'does trend-directed ingestion earn its coupling?' gate (REQ-005f). NOT the amplification `arm` — see ingestion_arm_is_not_the_amplification_arm below.

ratified_by.description: A named human ratified the `statement`. Model-drafted prose does not leave this system through an external API on a model's say-so. Same discipline as REQ-021 and REQ-037: a real human click.

ratification_note.description: REQUIRED, non-empty. Why this statement was accepted, in the ratifier's own words. Symmetric with the breaker's arming rule (Contract C: 'automatic to trip, manual WITH A RECORDED REASON to arm'). A click with no reason decays into a rubber stamp, which is exactly what REQ-021's triage sorter exists to prevent for approvals. Ratification volume and latency per cohort are reported to the operator as the decay signal.

warrant_ladder.description: What you are permitted to SAY, given what you have OBSERVED. Every rung above `contrasted` requires internal outcome data and is therefore out of scope by design (ADR-0006). Naming them is how the ceiling stays visible instead of being quietly forgotten.

rungs.requires: a predicate proposed from the corpus or a trend

rungs.may_say: recurs among high performers across unrelated trends
rungs.why_n_trends: Two unrelated trends is the minimum evidence that the structure outlives any one format. One trend is a trend.

rungs.requires: recurrent AND prevalence_ratio >= 2.0 on the mining slice AND prevalence_ratio >= 1.5 on a temporally disjoint slice
rungs.may_say: recurs among high performers AND is materially absent from the same creators' non-performers, on a slice it was not mined from
rungs.may_never_say: causes, lifts, predicts, drives, or any word implying an effect size

rungs.requires: a previously `contrasted` mechanism whose asymmetry did not survive a corpus refresh
rungs.retained: in the artefact, for auditability, forever

rungs.why: Reaching this rung means a tenant's outcome data informed a tenant-neutral artefact. The tenancy invariant (compliance-notes.md, 'The separation invariant') is not negotiable and this rung is the price of it. A Pattern reaches this rung; it stays inside its tenant.

rungs.requires: a deliberate stratified test: explore-budget allocations stratified on the predicate rather than on rank-uncertainty
rungs.why: Costs statistical power against the Thompson objective ADR-0003 chose, and at agency volume (hundreds of posts per year) would rarely have power to detect anything. Named so that nobody believes the API is making a causal claim it has not earned.

promotion_and_demotion.rule: Automatic to demote. Human to promote.
promotion_and_demotion.demote: On every corpus refresh, prevalence_ratio is recomputed on the new temporal slice. A `contrasted` mechanism whose asymmetry vanishes auto-demotes to `falsified` and is withdrawn from C4 the same cycle. No human step.
promotion_and_demotion.promote: A named human ratifies the `statement` before any rung is served. Promotion never happens on a timer.
promotion_and_demotion.why_asymmetric: Identical in shape to the circuit breaker in Contract C, and for the identical reason: the pressure to widen a threshold arrives at exactly the moment the threshold is telling the truth.

who_gates_this.why: C3's authority is calibration: it referees numeric predictions against measured outcomes. A Mechanism makes no numeric prediction and touches no outcome data, so there is nothing for C3 to referee. Giving C3 a veto here would be authority theatre. Its two authorities (breaker, library promotion) are unchanged and unextended.
who_gates_this.consequence: C4 has ZERO dependency on C3. It does not read Contract C. It cannot, because it serves nothing a breaker governs.

contract_e_mechanism_library_version.direction: C1 publishes an immutable artefact. C4 reads it. One way.
rules: Immutability. A published mechanism library version is never modified. A mechanism falsified in m4 still resolves in m3, because an API response served under m3 must remain reconstructible. Rollback is repointing active_version, not editing an artefact.
C4 never reads C1's internals, the Pattern Library, the OutcomeEvent log, or any tenant table. It reads one artefact-store prefix and nothing else.

C2 never reads this contract. A mechanism has no place in a score: it carries Proxy-selected evidence and no calibrated prediction, and VPS must remain reproducible from its pinned (extractor x rubric x pattern_library) triple. The rule that trends never enter VPS (ADR-0004) extends, unchanged in spirit, to mechanisms.
No mechanism, and nothing derived from one, is ever an input to a veto (V1-V6), a verdict, an AWS term, or a budget allocation.
Every C4 response carries: warrant, provenance.label, never_tested_against, mechanism_library_version, and sha256.
C4 emits no events. Contract B has exactly one writer and it is C2 (events-v1.json). C4 is read-only end to end.
